Diego — quick FAQ from Compliance/Legal review:

- We can permit a short public mention of our SOC 2 Type II attestation. We prefer the wording be limited to high-level statements (e.g., "Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II attestation covering controls for hosted inference services").
- We should not publish any control-level details, audit firm names, report dates, or scope boundaries (e.g., do not quote the specific testing procedures or internal control narratives).
- Please attach the SOC 2 summary PDF (Redwood_SOC2_Summary_v1.pdf) rather than the full report when sharing externally.
- If ClearPoint requests a signed attestation or an excerpt with signature block, route that to Compliance for a one-off review.

Suggested approved blurb (compliance-approved):
"Redwood Inference maintains a SOC 2 Type II attestation for security controls that apply to its hosted inference service."

I attached the short summary we allow partners/customers to reference. If they ask for edits, Compliance will triage.

- Laura
